newsitem.title: GERMANY: German winter crops dormant, weather mostly dry.
newsitem.headline: German winter crops dormant, weather mostly dry.

text.p: German winter crops were dormant as farmers completed the 1996 maize and sugar beet harvests, aided by dry weather, the DWD meteorological institute in Offenbach said in its weekly farm weather report on Friday.
"Farmers are carrying out clearance and maintenance work on partly frozen soils as temperatures are dropping," a DWD source said. "Conditions are normal for this time of the year."
He added grain and rapeseed crops for 1997 harvesting had had enough time in the autumn to harden ahead of frosts.
DWD forecast maximum day temperatures of six degrees C in the period to December 18, having recorded minus one to plus 10 degrees in the previous seven-day period.
